content: Different approaches of ASAM MCD-2MC and AUTOSAR with respect to SwRecordLayout ASAM MCD-2D specification (also known as A2L, or ASAP) uses keywords in record layouts where MSR/AUTOSAR uses the more generic approach specified here. It may happen that this generic approach cannot always be safely mapped to the A2L keywords. Therefore, SwRecordLayoutGroup . category can assist the conversion to the current A2L format.

Different approaches of ASAM MCD-2MC and AUTOSAR with respect to SwRecordLayout ASAM MCD-2D specification (also known as 443 of 1124  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 62: AUTOSAR_TPS_SoftwareComponentTemplate Software Component Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 A2L, or ASAP) uses keywords in record layouts where MSR/AUTOSAR uses the more generic approach specified here. It may happen that this generic approach cannot always be safely mapped to the A2L keywords. Therefore, SwRecordLayoutV . category as well as SwRecordLayout- Group . category can assist the conversion to the current A2L format.
